answer: Filling 128 aliases thus needs 128 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the tide record and indexed in the walnut history, the vine audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
